description: Buy a 24h Position Lifecycle bundle for one position subject and return the one-time control token. Use it when an agent needs guard, execution-receipt and close steps inside one prepaid window. Do not use it for a single guard (use check_trade_safety) and never share the token. Returns lifecycleId, the plc_ token, the covered expiry and the credits charged. Deprecated alias: prefer position_lifecycle with op "begin". Removed on 2027-01-06.
name: position_lifecycle_begin
